gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-brygada-1918: Stencil-cut and expressive: Balsamiq Sans has no pinched curves, while Brygada 1918 brings a serif with mild swelling. Balsamiq Sans earns its keep when it is big and brief.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-cactus-classical: Cactus Classical Serif reads with quiet authority, its e opened wide and its bowls shifting gently in weight. And with Balsamiq Sans above, long stretches of text settle into a steady, classic rhythm.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-caudex: Balsamiq Sans draws a line that never swells or tapers, with no tight, pinched curves anywhere. Caudex, a serif with gaping e mouths and gently graded curves, makes a dignified partner below.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-chiron-sung-hk: Chiron Sung HK is an editorial serif with a quiet authority. Its light modulation shows mainly up close, so beneath Balsamiq Sans headings, long reading moves along with ease.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-cinzel: Cinzel is loosely tracked and open, with only a modest gap between its stems and hairlines. And Balsamiq Sans, a rope-thin outline with no thick or thin parts, is worth giving generous size.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-diphylleia: Diphylleia reads bookish and classic, its apertures staying open down to tiny sizes. And Balsamiq Sans, with no thinner parts at all, is worth giving a bigger size than the text beneath.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-donegal-one: Refined is the feel of Donegal One, whose curves leave daylight and whose thins never turn spindly. While Balsamiq Sans excels at bold, parallel-edged display lines, Donegal One handles the mild stress of running text.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-fjord-one: Editorial, with wide-mouthed round letters, Fjord One sits beneath the unvarying stroke of Balsamiq Sans. Fjord One makes long reading feel gentle, its curves thinning slightly at the tops of rounded letters.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-gentium-book-plu: Traditional at heart, Gentium Book Plus sits under Balsamiq Sans. Its thin strokes run about half the weight of the thick ones, so extended reading moves with a gentle, classic rhythm.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-gfs-didot: GFS Didot brings a literary, authoritative voice, with generous gaps in its curves. GFS Didot against the wire-like constancy of Balsamiq Sans is the single quality that makes this pairing stand out.
